notes:
{就活|しゅうかつ} is an abbreviation of ⟦{就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧ (job-seeking activities). It primarily refers to the structured job-hunting process for university students.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {就活|しゅうかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}める→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧: to start job hunting
- {就活|しゅうかつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: in the middle of job hunting
- {就活|しゅうかつ}⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧: job-hunting suit (standard dark suit for interviews)
- {就活|しゅうかつ}⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧: job-hunting website
- {就活|しゅうかつ}⟦セミナー→セミナー：11000_seminaa⟧: job-hunting seminar

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {就活|しゅうかつ} follows a structured timeline: students typically begin in their third year of university, attending company information sessions (⟦{説明会|せつめいかい}→説明会：03087_setsumeikai⟧), submitting ⟦エントリーシート→エントリーシート：25018_entoriishiito⟧ (application forms), and going through multiple interview rounds. The process is largely standardized across companies.
